hooks.name: Sync Spec to Docs
hooks.description: When all tasks in a spec are complete, syncs its design.md (and requirements.md/bugfix.md only for cross-cutting capability features) from .kiro/specs/ to docs/features/business/. Never copies tasks.md.

action.prompt:
Check whether ALL tasks in the current spec's tasks.md are now marked complete. If not all are complete, do nothing.

If all tasks are complete, sync the spec's documentation into docs/features/business/{feature-name}/ (create the folder if needed), following the repository's docs/features convention:
- ALWAYS copy design.md.
- Copy requirements.md (or bugfix.md for a bugfix spec) ONLY when the feature is a cross-cutting/reusable capability whose behavioral contract carries lasting reference value (for example: audit, permissions, notifications, email, announcements, or cross-cutting refactors). For a small or narrowly-scoped feature, copy design.md only.
- NEVER copy tasks.md (implementation checklists are not retained in docs/features).

Business application specs sync under docs/features/business/. Do NOT write to docs/features/template/ - that directory is template-owned and is updated only by pulling from the template repository. See docs/features/README.md for the ownership split.
